Two injured, including officer, in shooting near Ontario synagogue

A man and a police officer were wounded in a shooting incident near a synagogue in Belleville, Ontario, on Yom Kippur. The Special Investigations Unit (SIU) is investigating the incident. Prime Minister Mark Carney had previously warned about a rise in antisemitism and the country's response to it.
